```plato

// Analysis-ready properties of a cross-section about its centroidal axes.
// Centroid is in meters in the section plane. Second moments and the torsion
// constant are in meters to the fourth power; section moduli are in cubic
// meters. Y and Z are the section's principal in-plane axes.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_moment_of_area)
type SectionProperties
    implements IValue
{
    Area: Area;
    Centroid: Point2D;
    SecondMomentY: Number;
    SecondMomentZ: Number;
    ProductMoment: Number;
    TorsionConstant: Number;
    SectionModulusY: Number;
    SectionModulusZ: Number;
}
```
